eyebrow: After weight loss · a new chapter
title: Make strength part of your next chapter.
description: After weight loss, you may be thinking about strength, movement and a routine that fits your changing life. Form is being developed to help keep your goals, experience and available time in view.
principle: A changing body deserves context. This preview does not prescribe a program or promise a physical outcome.
details: Make time for strength in everyday life
Revisit the plan as your circumstances change

title: A new starting point deserves a new plan.
description: Returning to movement after illness can bring different questions about energy, capacity and confidence. Form's intended experience leaves room for that context, once your clinician has cleared you to exercise.
principle: A preview cannot assess recovery or decide what is safe for you. Your clinician's guidance comes first.
details: Name the constraints that matter today
Make space to reconsider your available time
Bring questions about returning to exercise to your clinician

title: Move forward with your boundaries in view.
description: For people cleared by their clinician to exercise after injury, Form is developing a way to keep goals, preferences and limitations visible while planning movement. It is not rehabilitation or a substitute for your care team.
principle: Clinical clearance and any restrictions remain essential. Form does not diagnose an injury or prescribe rehabilitation.
details: Ask for explanations of proposed changes
Treat changing symptoms as a reason to consult your care team
